name: cloudbase
description: CloudBase MCP for OpenCode: manage Tencent CloudBase environments, cloud functions, databases, storage, hosting, and CloudRun with natural language — plus CloudBase AI Toolkit skills and rules.

installation.summary: Add CloudBase MCP to OpenCode config, then follow the official OpenCode setup guide.

usage.markdown:
## Usage

After MCP connects, ask OpenCode in natural language, for example:

- Build a WeChat Mini Program with CloudBase database and cloud functions
- Create a booking system on CloudBase PostgreSQL with auth and admin flows
- Enable phone-number login for a Web app via CloudBase Auth

More: [CloudBase AI Toolkit](https://docs.cloudbase.net/ai/cloudbase-ai-toolkit/) and the [OpenCode setup page](https://docs.cloudbase.net/ai/cloudbase-ai-toolkit/ide-setup/opencode).
